beats.care: A cheap festival day out with friends. Book early at ksrtc.in or call 080-26252625.
beats.what: KSRTC's Ashwamedha Classic buses leave Bengaluru at 6 am daily for a Mysuru sightseeing loop, Oct 13–28.
beats.why: Dasara draws huge crowds to Mysuru. A packaged trip saves you planning the route yourself.

cards.body: Children aged 6–12 pay Rs 750. These fares don't apply on Oct 19 and 20.
cards.caption: Adult fare

cards.body: Stops include Srirangapatna's temple and Daria Daulat Bagh, St Philomena's Church, Mysuru Palace, the zoo and Chamundi Hills.

cards.q: When does KSRTC's Mysuru day tour leave Bengaluru?
cards.why: KSRTC says the tour bus departs Bengaluru at 6 am.

hook: Mysuru Palace, zoo and Chamundi in *one day* for under Rs 1,000?

learn.t: The tour covers Srirangapatna, Mysuru Palace, the zoo and Chamundi Hills in a single day.

sources.name: Deccan Herald
sources.title: KSRTC's Bengaluru-Mysuru package tours from Oct 13 to 28

tldr: KSRTC is running one-day Bengaluru–Mysuru package tours from October 13 to 28 for Rs 950 per adult.
watch: Tours run daily until October 28; the Rs 950 fare doesn't apply on October 19 and 20.
